title.zh: 食品加工场所执照（第 20-C 条）

agency.en: New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets, Division of Food Safety and Inspection
agency.zh: 纽约州农业与市场部食品安全与检查处

how.en: Mailed to the Department's Food Safety License Unit in Albany with the fee (a check, a money order or the card authorization form), signed in ink by an owner or officer. An inspection graded A comes before the license.
how.zh: 连同费用（支票、汇票或信用卡授权表）邮寄至奥尔巴尼的农业与市场部食品安全执照组，须由所有人或高管亲笔签名。发证前须通过检查并获得 A 级评定。

feeNote.en: $400, or $175 for a business with no more than 10 full-time employees; the application fee is non-refundable.
feeNote.zh: 400 美元；全职员工不超过 10 人的企业为 175 美元。申请费不予退还。

label.en: Business name (corporation, LLC or individual owner name, partnership) and county
label.zh: 企业名称（公司、LLC 或个人业主姓名、合伙）及所在县

label.en: Trade name/DBA and business location street address
label.zh: 营业名称及营业场所街道地址

label.en: Optional mailing address
label.zh: 邮寄地址（可选）

label.en: Federal ID or State EIN number
label.zh: 联邦税号或州 EIN

label.en: Sole proprietor, officers, partners or members
label.zh: 独资业主、高管、合伙人或成员

label.en: Foreign or out-of-New-York-state applicant
label.zh: 是否为外国或纽约州以外的申请人

label.en: If out of New York State: person and address designated to accept service of process
label.zh: 如在纽约州以外：指定接收法律文书的人员及地址

label.en: Food processing activities at this location
label.zh: 本场所的食品加工活动

label.en: Workers' compensation insurance status and insurer
label.zh: 工伤保险状况及承保公司

label.en: Original signature of owner, partner or corporate officer, title and date
label.zh: 所有人、合伙人或公司高管亲笔签名、职务及日期

foreign.en: An out-of-state applicant names a person and address to accept service of process by first class mail (line 4f).
foreign.zh: 州外申请人须在第 4f 行指定以平信接收法律文书的人员和地址。

plain.en: New York's license for a place that makes or packs food, from the state's Department of Agriculture.
plain.zh: 纽约州农业部为生产或包装食品的场所发放的执照。

proof.quote: Article 20-C Food Processing Establishment licenses apply to food manufactures, processing plants, wholesale bakeries,

title.zh: 食品仓库执照（第 28-D 条）

agency.en: New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets, Division of Food Safety and Inspection
agency.zh: 纽约州农业与市场部食品安全与检查处

how.en: One application per location, mailed to the Food Safety License Unit in Albany with the fee, signed in ink by an owner or officer.
how.zh: 每个地点单独申请，连同费用邮寄至奥尔巴尼的食品安全执照组，须由所有人或高管亲笔签名。

renews.en: Expires two years from the date it is issued.
renews.zh: 自签发之日起两年后到期。

label.en: Individual owner name, partnership or full name of the corporation, county and trade name
label.zh: 个人业主姓名、合伙或公司全称、所在县及营业名称

label.en: Street, city, state and ZIP of the warehouse
label.zh: 仓库街道、城市、州及邮编

label.en: Optional mailing address
label.zh: 邮寄地址（可选）

label.en: Federal ID number
label.zh: 联邦税号

label.en: Sole proprietors and all officers, or partners and members
label.zh: 独资业主及全部高管，或合伙人与成员

label.en: Foreign or out-of-New-York-state applicant
label.zh: 是否为外国或纽约州以外的申请人

label.en: Original signature of owner, partner or corporate officer, title and date
label.zh: 所有人、合伙人或公司高管亲笔签名、职务及日期

plain.en: New York's license for a warehouse that holds food for commercial distribution.
plain.zh: 纽约州为存放待商业分销食品的仓库发放的执照。

proof.quote: If you are a warehouse that stores/distributes food (excluding Raw Agriculture Commodities (RACs), you need a 28-D license.

title.zh: 零售食品店执照（第 28-A 条）

agency.en: New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets, Division of Food Safety and Inspection
agency.zh: 纽约州农业与市场部食品安全与检查处

how.en: For a store selling food to take away that does no food processing; a store that slices, cooks or makes sandwiches needs the Article 20-C license instead. One application per location, mailed to the Food Safety License Unit in Albany with the fee, signed in ink.
how.zh: 适用于销售外带食品且不进行任何食品加工的商店；切片、烹饪或制作三明治的商店须改办第 20-C 条执照。每个门店单独申请，连同费用邮寄至奥尔巴尼的食品安全执照组，须亲笔签名。

renews.en: Expires two years from the date it is issued.
renews.zh: 自签发之日起两年后到期。

label.en: Individual owner name, partnership or full name of the corporation, county and trade name
label.zh: 个人业主姓名、合伙或公司全称、所在县及营业名称

label.en: Street, city, state and ZIP of the store
label.zh: 门店街道、城市、州及邮编

label.en: Optional mailing address
label.zh: 邮寄地址（可选）

label.en: Federal ID number
label.zh: 联邦税号

label.en: Sole proprietors and all officers, or partners and members
label.zh: 独资业主及全部高管，或合伙人与成员

label.en: Original signature of owner, partner or corporate officer, title and date
label.zh: 所有人、合伙人或公司高管亲笔签名、职务及日期

plain.en: New York's state license for a grocery or other store that sells packaged food to take away.
plain.zh: 纽约州为销售外带包装食品的杂货店等商店发放的州执照。

proof.quote: This license applies to any retail food store within New York where food and food products are offered to the consumer

agency.en: New Jersey Department of Health, Public Health and Food Protection Program
agency.zh: 新泽西州卫生局公共卫生与食品保护项目

how.en: For a business that makes, repacks, distributes wholesale or warehouses food in New Jersey. Pay the fee online first, then email Form F-29 with the payment confirmation number to wfc@doh.nj.gov.
how.zh: 适用于在新泽西州生产、重新包装、批发分销或仓储食品的企业。先在线缴费，再将 F-29 表连同付款确认号通过电子邮件发送至 wfc@doh.nj.gov。

feeNote.en: By gross annual wholesale volume: $150 for $100,000 or less, $500 up to $500,000, $1,000 above that.
feeNote.zh: 按年批发总额计：10 万美元及以下 150 美元，50 万美元以下 500 美元，超过 50 万美元 1,000 美元。

renews.en: Every year, on a new F-29.
renews.zh: 每年续期，须重新填写 F-29 表。

label.en: New applicant, renewal, change of ownership or relocation
label.zh: 新申请、续期、所有权变更或迁址

label.en: Name of firm as it should appear on the license, and DBA
label.zh: 执照上显示的企业名称及营业名称

label.en: Facility address, city, state, ZIP and county
label.zh: 设施地址、城市、州、邮编及县

label.en: Full legal name of owner (person or business) and phone
label.zh: 所有人（个人或企业）法定全名及电话

label.en: FDA Establishment ID, number of employees, annual gross sales
label.zh: FDA 设施编号、员工人数、年总销售额

label.en: Operations and products (manufacture or process, repack, wholesale, storage)
label.zh: 经营活动及产品（生产加工、重新包装、批发、仓储）

label.en: Gross annual wholesale volume and payment confirmation number
label.zh: 年批发总额及付款确认号

label.en: Full name, title and signature of owner, officer or responsible person
label.zh: 所有人、高管或负责人全名、职务及签名

plain.en: New Jersey's yearly license for a business that makes, packs, distributes or stores food wholesale.
plain.zh: 新泽西州为批发生产、包装、分销或储存食品的企业发放的年度执照。

proof.quote: To apply for a new license or to renew annually, download and complete application form F-29.

title.en: Food establishment registration (manufacturer, processor, distributor or warehouse)
title.zh: 食品场所登记（生产商、加工商、分销商或仓库）

agency.en: Pennsylvania Department of Agriculture, Bureau of Food Safety and Laboratory Services
agency.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州农业部食品安全与实验室服务局

how.en: Email the application packet and plans to RA-AGPLANREVIEW@pa.gov (preferred), or mail or fax them, at least 60 days before operating. Send no money: the fee is collected after a compliant inspection.
how.zh: 至少在开始经营前 60 天将申请材料和图纸通过电子邮件发送至 RA-AGPLANREVIEW@pa.gov（首选），或邮寄、传真。无需随附费用：检查合格后收取。

feeNote.en: Collected after the inspection; checks payable to "Commonwealth of Pennsylvania".
feeNote.zh: 检查合格后收取；支票抬头为 "Commonwealth of Pennsylvania"。

takes.en: Submit at least 60 days before operating.
takes.zh: 须至少在开始经营前 60 天提交。

plain.en: Pennsylvania's registration for any business that makes, packs, stores or distributes food, from the Department of Agriculture.
plain.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州农业部对生产、包装、储存或分销食品的企业的登记。

proof.quote: Owners of such food businesses must first get a Food Registration.

agency.en: Pennsylvania Department of Agriculture, Bureau of Food Safety and Laboratory Services
agency.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州农业部食品安全与实验室服务局

how.en: Where the Department is the licensor. A place with its own local health department (Philadelphia among them) is licensed by that department instead, so check the county or city first. Email the packet and plans to RA-AGPLANREVIEW@pa.gov, or mail or fax them; the fee is collected after a compliant inspection.
how.zh: 适用于由州农业部发证的地区。设有本地卫生部门的地方（包括费城）由该部门发证，请先确认所在县或市。将申请材料和图纸通过电子邮件发送至 RA-AGPLANREVIEW@pa.gov，或邮寄、传真；检查合格后收取费用。

feeNote.en: $241 for a new facility, $103 if under 50 seats and owner operated; collected after the inspection.
feeNote.zh: 新设施 241 美元；座位少于 50 个且由业主经营的为 103 美元；检查合格后收取。

plain.en: Pennsylvania's license for a restaurant, grocery or other place selling food, where the state is the licensor.
plain.zh: 在由州发证的地区，宾夕法尼亚州为餐厅、杂货店等售卖食品场所发放的执照。

proof.quote: All retailers are required to obtain a Retail Food Facility License PRIOR to operating a Retail Food Facility.

agency.en: Maryland Department of Health, Office of Food Protection, Center for Food Processing
agency.zh: 马里兰州卫生部食品保护办公室食品加工中心

how.en: For a facility that makes, processes, stores, holds or distributes food sold wholesale in Maryland. One application covers every plant type; the Office of Food Protection (6 St. Paul Street, Suite 1301, Baltimore) confirms how to submit it.
how.zh: 适用于在马里兰州生产、加工、储存、存放或分销批发食品的设施。各类工厂共用同一份申请表；提交方式请向食品保护办公室（巴尔的摩 6 St. Paul Street, Suite 1301）确认。

feeNote.en: $400 a year for a food manufacturing plant, bakery, cannery or confectionery; other plant types differ.
feeNote.zh: 食品制造厂、烘焙厂、罐头厂或糖果厂每年 400 美元；其他类型不同。

plain.en: Maryland's license for a plant or warehouse that makes, holds or distributes food sold wholesale.
plain.zh: 马里兰州为生产、存放或分销批发食品的工厂或仓库发放的执照。

proof.quote: licensing and inspecting facilities that make, process, store, hold or distribute food to sell wholesale

form: Permit Application for Food Manufacturer or Food Storage Warehouse (VDACS-FSP-APPMF)

title.en: Food manufacturer or food storage warehouse permit
title.zh: 食品生产商或食品仓储许可证

agency.en: Virginia Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, Food Safety Program
agency.zh: 弗吉尼亚州农业与消费者服务部食品安全项目

how.en: Email the completed application and its supporting documents to foodsafety@vdacs.virginia.gov at least 60 calendar days before opening. A preoperational inspection follows approval.
how.zh: 至少在开业前 60 个日历日将填好的申请表及证明文件通过电子邮件发送至 foodsafety@vdacs.virginia.gov。获批后进行开业前检查。

feeNote.en: No fee with the application. A $40 annual inspection fee is invoiced in the next billing cycle.
feeNote.zh: 申请时不收费。每年 40 美元的检查费在下一个计费周期开具账单。

takes.en: Submit at least 60 calendar days before opening.
takes.zh: 须至少在开业前 60 个日历日提交。

plain.en: Virginia's permit for a place that makes food or stores it in a warehouse.
plain.zh: 弗吉尼亚州为生产食品或仓储食品的场所发放的许可证。

proof.quote: It is unlawful to operate as a food manufacturer, food storage warehouse, or retail food establishment until it has been inspected

form: Permit Application for a Retail Food Establishment (VDACS-FSP-APPRF)

title.en: Retail food establishment permit (grocery, convenience store, seafood market)
title.zh: 零售食品场所许可证（杂货店、便利店、海鲜市场）

agency.en: Virginia Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, Food Safety Program
agency.zh: 弗吉尼亚州农业与消费者服务部食品安全项目

how.en: Email the completed application to foodsafety@vdacs.virginia.gov at least 30 calendar days before opening; an inspector then schedules the preoperational inspection.
how.zh: 至少在开业前 30 个日历日将填好的申请表通过电子邮件发送至 foodsafety@vdacs.virginia.gov；之后检查员会安排开业前检查。

feeNote.en: No fee with the application. A $40 annual inspection fee is invoiced in the next billing cycle.
feeNote.zh: 申请时不收费。每年 40 美元的检查费在下一个计费周期开具账单。

takes.en: Submit at least 30 calendar days before opening.
takes.zh: 须至少在开业前 30 个日历日提交。

plain.en: Virginia's state permit for a grocery, convenience store or seafood market.
plain.zh: 弗吉尼亚州为杂货店、便利店或海鲜市场发放的州许可证。

proof.quote: It is unlawful to operate as a retail food manufacturer, food storage warehouse, or retail food establishment until it has been inspected

form: Form CRA, Combined Registration Application (Delaware One Stop)

title.en: Delaware business license and withholding registration
title.zh: 特拉华州营业执照及预扣税登记

how.en: Applied for online through Delaware One Stop. Delaware has no sales tax; the license carries the gross receipts tax. An employer also registers as a withholding agent in Part B of the same form.
how.zh: 通过 Delaware One Stop 在线申请。特拉华州不征销售税，营业执照对应总收入税。雇主须在同一表格的 B 部分登记为预扣税代扣人。

feeNote.en: Set by business activity and prorated in the first year; the Division of Revenue states the amount.
feeNote.zh: 按业务类别计算，首年按比例收取；具体金额以税务局为准。

takes.en: Most businesses receive the license within a month.
takes.zh: 多数企业在一个月内收到执照。

renews.en: Every year by December 31 (or a three-year license).
renews.zh: 每年 12 月 31 日前续期（或办理三年期执照）。

plain.en: Delaware's state business license, which every business there needs, with the employer withholding account on the same form.
plain.zh: 特拉华州所有企业都须办理的州营业执照，雇主预扣税账户在同一表格中登记。

proof.quote: Any person or entity conducting a trade or business in the State of Delaware is required to obtain a Delaware business license

form: Unemployment insurance employer registration (Delaware One Stop)

agency.en: Delaware Department of Labor, Division of Unemployment Insurance
agency.zh: 特拉华州劳工部失业保险处

how.en: Filed online in Delaware One Stop with the business license, once the business has employees working in Delaware.
how.zh: 企业在特拉华州有员工后，通过 Delaware One Stop 与营业执照一并在线提交。

plain.en: Registers you as an employer for Delaware unemployment insurance, filed with the business license.
plain.zh: 登记为特拉华州失业保险雇主，与营业执照一并办理。

proof.quote: If you have employees working in Delaware, you will also need to file Workers' Compensation and Unemployment Insurance forms

form: Food Establishment Plan Review and Permit Application

agency.en: Delaware Division of Public Health, Office of Food Protection
agency.zh: 特拉华州公共卫生处食品保护办公室

how.en: The plan review and permit application are mailed together to the Office of Food Protection in Dover with the plan review fee (walk-ins are not accepted). The permit fee is invoiced once the place is approved to operate.
how.zh: 图纸审核与许可证申请一并连同审图费邮寄至多佛的食品保护办公室（不接受现场递交）。场所获准营业后另开许可证费账单。

feeNote.en: Plan review fee by the schedule in the packet, checks payable to "State of Delaware"; the permit fee is invoiced after approval.
feeNote.zh: 审图费按申请包中的收费表计算，支票抬头为 "State of Delaware"；许可证费获批后开具账单。

takes.en: Plans are reviewed within 60 working days in the order received.
takes.zh: 图纸按收到顺序在 60 个工作日内审核。

plain.en: Delaware's state permit for a restaurant, grocery or other place that serves or sells food; the state issues it everywhere in Delaware.
plain.zh: 特拉华州为餐厅、杂货店等供应或销售食品场所发放的州许可证，全州统一由州政府签发。

proof.quote: The Division of Public Health issues permits to almost 4,000 food establishments.

form: Form WV/BUS-APP, Application for Business Registration Certificate (One Stop Business Portal)

title.en: West Virginia business registration certificate (sales and use tax, withholding)
title.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州营业登记证书（销售和使用税、预扣税）

how.en: Registered online in the One Stop Business Portal before business starts; the Tax Division assigns an account for each tax the business owes, sales and use tax and withholding included. The certificate is posted where the business is conducted.
how.zh: 开业前通过 One Stop Business Portal 在线登记；税务处为企业应缴的每个税种（包括销售和使用税及预扣税）分配账户。证书须张贴在营业场所。

feeNote.en: Plus a $1 portal fee for filings made online.
feeNote.zh: 在线提交另收 1 美元门户费。

plain.en: West Virginia's tax registration that every business needs before it starts, covering sales tax and payroll withholding.
plain.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州所有企业开业前都须办理的税务登记，涵盖销售税和工资预扣税。

proof.quote: must register with the West Virginia State Tax Division before commencing business activities

agency.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州劳动力署（WorkForce West Virginia）

how.en: Required of any business with employees and of every corporation or LLC. Filed with the One Stop registration, or on the Employers Initial Statement emailed to uctaxunit@wv.gov (the preferred way).
how.zh: 凡有员工的企业以及所有公司或 LLC 都须登记。可随 One Stop 登记一并提交，或填写雇主初始声明表通过电子邮件发送至 uctaxunit@wv.gov（首选方式）。

plain.en: Registers the business with West Virginia's unemployment program; a corporation or LLC registers even before it hires.
plain.zh: 在西弗吉尼亚州失业保险项目登记；公司或 LLC 即使尚未雇人也须登记。

proof.quote: you are required by law to register with WorkForce West Virginia
